mapper.insert: INSERT INTO infoflow_hot_repo (repo_full_name, repo_name, description, html_url, stars, forks, language, topics, source, published_at, collected_date, collected_at) VALUES (#{fullName}, #{name}, #{description}, #{htmlUrl}, #{stars}, #{forks}, #{language}, #{topics}, #{source}, #{publishedAt}, #{collectedDate}, #{collectedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description = VALUES(description), html_url = VALUES(html_url), stars = VALUES(stars), forks = VALUES(forks), language = VALUES(language), topics = VALUES(topics), collected_at = VALUES(collected_at)
